sources.note: Nothing on stress. Comparative lexical study; footnote 6 (p. 319) reproduces 38 Opón-Carare forms from Pineda Giraldo & Fornaguera 1958 with their accent marks (jór-id, tainaú-ño, totó-id, monó-ño, wapoté, pómboka..) and quotes that source's transcription conventions from its p. 193 (palatal semiconsonant, schwa-like vowel, '=' a 'hipo o alto en la voz'), but says nothing about what the acute marks or where accent falls.
